name: Marcus Delaney
summary: B2B SaaS account executive with 5 years of closing experience (plus 1 year as an SDR), the last 3+ years selling to mid-market companies (200-2,000 employees). Consistently over quota (112%, 124% and 131% in the last three fiscal years). Runs full-cycle new-logo deals of $25k-$120k ACV with 60-120 day cycles; disciplined Salesforce user, accurate forecaster, MEDDICC qualification, multi-threading and procurement negotiation. US citizen.

experience.description: HR and workforce management SaaS. Full-cycle new-logo sales in a Central-region mid-market territory of ~400 accounts. 131% of a $1.1M new-ARR quota in FY2025, 124% in FY2024, 112% in FY2023; President's Club 2024 and 2025. Grew average deal size from $38k to $61k ACV; closed a $148k ACV deal through security, legal and procurement. Forecast accuracy within +/-5% for six quarters; coaches two newer AEs with Gong.
Marketing analytics SaaS. Closed short-cycle SMB and agency deals ($8k-$25k ACV, 20-45 day cycles); 108% of annual quota; 6-8 demos per week and a 60+ opportunity pipeline in Salesforce.
Outbound prospecting with Outreach and ZoomInfo; averaged 14 qualified meetings per month (118% of target). Promoted to Account Executive after 18 months.
